0022600155.text: The Pacers (2-3, 10th in the East and 2 games back in the Central) host the Nets (0-4, 15th in the East), who have lost four straight and sit 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, while Indiana is on a two-game losing streak and 0-2 at home. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The Pacers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning 136-109 in Brooklyn on October 25, and they also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
